pages.text: $(o)An empty suit of armor that still swings its axe, sealed in a chamber under the Hearthlands.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() Blows on its front plate do next to nothing. Let the axe miss, then strike its back while it hauls the blade free.$(br2)This fight is about timing, not damage. Watch before you swing.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Wrought Rivet$() counts for the quest book.
